subject: problem encountered when installing CMTK plugin on imagej for windows

messages.author: bf7c0a7b58a65524
messages.subject: problem encountered when installing CMTK plugin on imagej for windows
parts:
Hi NBLAST useres,
 
I am having difficulty installing the CMTK registration plugin on my windows laptop. When I press "install CMTK" I receive the following error messages

  • console: Failed to install '': java.nio.charset.UnsupportedCharsetException: cp0. [ERROR] Traceback (most recent call last)
  • ror: java.lang.UnsatisfiedLinkError: java.lang.UnsatisfiedLinkError: org.scijava.jython.shaded.com.kenai.jffi.Foreign.getVersion()I
The full error message has been pasted into the attached file.

I have installed java but that doesn’t seem to have made any difference. It is worth noting my programming abiliity is fairly limited.  Any help to resolve this issue would be massivley appreciated!

messages.author: 7f0257cd1389289f
messages.subject: Re: problem encountered when installing CMTK plugin on imagej for windows
parts:
Dear George,

Thanks for your interest in CMTK and the NBLAST tools.

It seems that you are on Windows. I have had a really hard time supporting jython (what ImageJ uses to run python scripts) on different platforms and especially on Windows. Things break regularly. However recently some CMTK users on Windows were able to offer some help for what may be the same problem. Please see this thread on the CMTK forum

https://www.nitrc.org/forum/forum.php?thread_id=11060&forum_id=857

With best wishes,

Greg.
